_comment: Selectors for the browser fallback path (id4me_bot.py). The day-to-day tool is lookup.py, which calls the JSON API directly and needs none of this. Each key is an ordered list of candidates; the first that resolves to a visible element wins. All values below were confirmed against the live site, not guessed.

_site_notes.framework: React + Material UI. Element ids like '_r_7_' are auto-generated per render - never select on them.
_site_notes.auth: Auth0 tenant id4me.au.auth0.com, OAuth2 PKCE, audience ' Id4me-search-v2' (leading space is real).
_site_notes.search_modes: A MUI split button toggles 'Search' (classic) and 'Smart Search' (Beta, natural language). The choice persists in localStorage under 'searchMode'. Classic is the one that takes addresses.
_site_notes.tooltip_trap: A MuiTooltip popper overlays the mode menu and swallows Playwright clicks. Click those menu items via page.evaluate, not locator.click.
